name: Recipe Box
description: Keep your recipes with photos, tags, servings that rescale the quantities and a cook mode that keeps the screen on. Snap a cookbook page and your AI copies it.
prompt: A recipe box with photos, tags and search, servings that rescale quantities, ingredients you can tick off, a cook mode with big steps that keeps the screen on, and an AI that copies a recipe from a photo.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Guarda tus recetas con fotos, etiquetas, raciones que recalculan las cantidades y un modo cocina que mantiene la pantalla encendida. Haz una foto a un libro y tu IA la copia.
